title: Who marks and edits progress outside support marking
question: In ML-method projects, may users edit progress or only report discrepancies? Who sets a project's method? For clients marking progress on an iPad, how are offline marks queued and synced, how are simultaneous edits resolved, and what device data protection is required?
context: The web app switches behaviour on a per-project ML-method flag (PROG-REQ-058) and limits predictions to those projects (PROG-REQ-071). The progress monitoring PRD leaves editing in the ML method to leadership, and the iPad PRD leaves offline handling and security open.
